decisions.rationale: Command injection in lodash via the template function (NVD primary CWE-94); lodash is a transitive dep of everything. CVE-2021-23337.
SSRF via crafted URL in axios; the service fetches user-supplied URLs. CVE-2020-28168.
Prototype pollution in minimist but only reachable via CLI arg parsing in our build scripts, not at runtime. Revisit if minimist moves into the request path. CVE-2021-44906.
Vulnerabilities reachable only through devDependencies are deprioritized: they never ship to production. Fix on the next scheduled dependency update.
Findings against test fixtures and example apps are not real exposure. Ignored by policy, not by oversight.
